_comment: Budget for the contract-size CI gate. See script/ci/check_contract_sizes.py.
Limits are the protocol constants: EIP-170 caps deployed runtime bytecode,
EIP-3860 caps initcode. fail_pct is the fraction of a limit a contract may reach
before CI fails, so the gate bites while there is still room to react rather than
at deploy time. warn_pct only annotates the report.
Add an entry to `overrides` to accept a contract above fail_pct. An override is a
recorded decision, not an exemption: max_runtime_bytes is still a hard ceiling, so
the contract cannot grow further without another deliberate change here. Keep the
reason current and delete the entry once the bytes are reclaimed.
